name: Deschutes River (Maupin)
blurb: Oregon's most-run whitewater day trip. Dam-fed, warm, and steady all summer through the canyon at Maupin.

sections.notes: Wapinitia and Boxcar are the big ones. A Deschutes boater pass is required for every person.

putInAccess.sourceName: Oregon State Marine Board Boat Oregon access inventory
putInAccess.note: Agency launch record and satellite imagery agree on this riverside access facility. The marker is an approximate facility location, not a surveyed landing edge.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed public entrance and designated river access at Harpham Flat. Check the operator’s current hours and seasonal conditions before arranging the shuttle.

sections.notes: BLM’s boater guide rates Oak Springs Rapid Class IV; scout it from the road on river right. Take out at Sandy Beach before Sherars Falls. Arrange the road shuttle in advance.

notices.title: Mandatory exit before Sherars Falls
notices.text: Sandy Beach is the last takeout before Sherars Falls. All boaters must leave the river there or upstream. Continuing into the next river segment requires a vehicle portage.
